range.title: The range
range.lead: Three everyday roasts and six specials that taste of home. Whole bean or ground to order.
story.title: From bean to sip
story.s1.b: We pick beans for the cup, not the label: chocolate and nuts for black coffee, softer and sweeter for milk.
story.s2.b: Roasted in Bangladesh in small batches, rested, then packed in a bag with a one-way valve so it stays fresh.
story.s3.b: Brew it the way you already do: a moka pot, a pour-over, a French press or a pot on the stove.
brew.title: Three ways to start
brew.lead: One for black, one for milk, one for every day.
sub.title: Never run out
sub.lead: A fresh bag at your door every two or four weeks. 10% off every bag, skip or cancel any time.
order.title: Your order
order.lead: We confirm every order on WhatsApp or Messenger. Pay with bKash, Nagad or cash on delivery.
